model: CWLP / CWXP wall CO2 sensor with BACnet MS/TP (older generation)
applies_to: Veris CWLP and CWXP wall CO2 sensors with optional humidity, temperature and slider, set to BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The CWLP/CWXP is the older Veris wall CO2 sensor with a relay output and an RS-485 port that runs BACnet MS/TP or Modbus (DIP switch 1). It reports CO2 plus optional humidity, temperature and slider position, and has writable relay setpoint/deadband, ABC calibration mode, offsets, units and an override button flag. It is the predecessor of the CW2 Protocol series and uses a different object set.
notes: The objects table has no access column; AV and BV objects are marked writable from the guide's descriptions, AI and BI as read-only.
Humidity, temperature, slider, the offsets and the override button only exist on models with those options.
BV 2 Relay_Override and BV 4 Override are volatile; the other settings are kept.
Auto_Cal (ABC) settings: 0 normal (building empty within 24 h), 1 low (occupied 24 h), 2 off.

integration.summary: Set DIP switch 1 down for BACnet, set the MS/TP address on switches 2-8 and the baud rate on the configuration switches, then read CO2_Level and any fitted humidity, temperature or slider values.

minimum_points.name: Override
minimum_points.why: Override button pressed; write 0 to clear

setup: Address DIP switch 1: down = BACnet, up = Modbus. Switches 2-8 add 64/32/16/8/4/2/1 to the MS/TP address (0-127).
Configuration DIP switches 3-4 set the baud rate: BACnet 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800.
Default device instance is 133nnn (nnn = MS/TP address); it can be changed and is remembered. Max_Master default 127.
gotchas: BV 4 Override latches until the BMS writes 0.
CO2 calibration needs a Veris gas kit; BV 3 Cal_Lockout must be cleared first.

points.name: Device_Instance
points.description: Alternative way to set the device instance; negative restores 133nnn

points.name: Relay_On
points.description: Relay energized by gas level (ignores BV 2)

points.name: Override
points.description: Override button pressed; write 0 to reset (if present)
